races.name: Vesperi
races.desc: Small, quick winged folk who pick up any skill twice as fast as they put it down.

races.name: Ironclad
races.desc: Walking foundries. Shrug off 30% of weapon damage, move like it too.

races.name: Lumen
races.desc: Beings of soft light who slowly heal everyone in the room with them.

races.name: Gloomkin
races.desc: Shadow-dwellers who need no air and no one inside their heads.

sectors.name: The Wing Sky
sectors.blurb: Vesperi flocks on fast skimmers. Friendly, if you can keep up.

sectors.name: The Forge Belt
sectors.blurb: Ironclad mining country: asteroids, ore haulers and very slow conversations.

events.text: A flock of Vesperi skimmers swoops around your ship, wingtips glittering. Their leader hails: "Race us to the next star. Winner takes the loser's lunch."

effect.text: You win by a nose. The Vesperi laugh, hand over their lunch and one of them asks to join your crew.

success.text: Somehow you win. The Vesperi are delighted and pay up.

fail.text: You lose badly. Lunch is a crate of your fuel.

effect.text: They tease you for three jumps' worth of radio chatter, then share a map of the area.

events.text: An Ironclad smelter the size of a city hangs over a molten moon. The foreman offers to reforge your hull plates, for a price.

choices.text: Pay for a full reforge (45 scrap).

effect.text: Your hull comes back heavier, thicker and still warm.

choices.text: Trade them your spare missiles for ore.

effect.text: The foreman likes explosives. You get a good price.
An Ironclad apprentice clanks aboard with a duffel bag of tools.

events.text: A Lumen drifts alone in the dark, glowing faintly. It seems to be waiting for something, or someone.

effect.text: The Lumen settles into your medbay and the whole ship feels warmer.

choices.text: Ask what it is waiting for.

success.text: "For you to ask." It shows you a hidden cache before it leaves.

fail.text: It does not answer. It just glows a little dimmer and drifts away.

events.text: Your lights dim. Shapes move in the corners of your corridors. A Gloomkin is aboard, and it is very curious.

choices.text: Turn the lights back up and confront it.

success.text: It blinks, apologises and asks for a job.

fail.text: It panics and wrecks a console on the way out.

choices.text: Leave it a snack and wait.

effect.text: The snack disappears. So does the Gloomkin. In the morning you find it left you something shiny.

choices.text: Have your telepath talk it down.

effect.text: {who} has a quiet word with it. The Gloomkin stays, and so does its loot.
